Match each student to their emperor and grade, and determine the length of each presentation. Remember, as with all grid-based logic puzzles, no option in any category will ever be used more than once.

2. Neal talked about Diocletian.

4. The student who gave the presentation on Nero spoke 2 minutes more than Vickie.
5. Omar was either the presenter who gave the presentation on Nero or the presenter who spoke for 10 minutes.

lengths: 6 minutes; 8 minutes; 10 minutes; 12 minutes.
